rationale: The active reco.nz index parser exposes both method and reconstructor fields on index rows. The retained G7-P3 linkage artifact intentionally stripped these fields, while archived G7-P2/P3 code proves they were previously used in population geometry. Therefore a full index-only recovery is strictly less invasive and more informative than 200 solve-body requests.

authority_boundary.live_index_role: covariate backfill only; current live rows do not redefine the frozen population
authority_boundary.new_live_ids: record aggregate drift counts only; exclude from P8 transport analyses

fallback.activation_condition: only if index-only census cannot provide sufficient method/reconstructor coverage for the frozen population

promotion_gate.method_reconstructor_transport: HOLD until index-only census and downstream population transport court
